quests.title: Locked Rooms
quests.summary: Pledges vanish from the locked strongroom at Vance House. The Vance who runs the Rag Mill wants a plain answer for the House.

offer.say: #greet#, #address#. Pledges gone from our strongroom on the Rise: a ring, a clip, a bracelet. No lock forced, no window open. The Heights say a Quickened wolf walks through walls. Petra wants a plain answer, and so do I. Look the house over, ask about, and watch our street one night.
offer.thanks: #thanks#. Nobody by the street. Then by what, the open air? There's an old street under these houses, they say, from before the walls. Find where it opens, and find who knows it.

objectives.label: Look Vance House over from its door: no lock forced, no window open.
Ask the Harrowgates' man, out on the Rise all day, what he hears at night.
Ask the Eastgate stable keeper what went from the Thornburys' harness.
Watch the Vance street one night.

rewards.detail: watched the Vance street for the wall-walking thief

quests.title: Under the Street
quests.summary: Follow the scent of old stone to the Sunken Street, find the bricked arch by its far door, and find who knows the old street.

objectives.label: Follow the scent of old stone to the Sunken Street's Commons stair.
Find the bricked arch by the Sunken Street's far door, and what's behind it.
Pick up a pledge from the cache.
Find the one who knows the old street.

quests.title: What Is Owed
quests.summary: Give the pledges back to their owners, and put Petra Vance's rates plainly to the Vance at the Rag Mill.

objectives.label: Tell the young wolf who knows the old street what she did.
Give the brass harness clip back to the timber feller upstairs in the Slop Rooms.
Give the silver bracelet back to the porter on Oakum Stair.
Give the ear-ring back to its owner at Rag End.
Put Petra's rates plainly to the Vance at the Rag Mill.

phases.journal: Pledges vanish from a locked strongroom on the Rise, and the Heights whisper of a wall-walking thief.

effects.text: Lock your doors, they say. Ours were locked. Bright One keep us from wolves who walk through walls.

triggers.note: Each visit: the residents' choices and a fresh shared goal; the rumour walks the Heights.

effect.words: Have you heard anything on the Rise at night?
effect.reply: I'm out on the Rise from first light, and I go home late. There's scratching under the street at night, like something in the drains, and the Vance cellars smell of old stone and wet. Nobody believes a servant.

effect.words: Was anything taken from the Thornburys?
effect.reply: Not from the house. The Thornburys stable here, and their master bought a brass clip off Vance House last winter, a pledge somebody in the Sump never paid back. It went off his harness, off my own peg. Funny sort of thief, that takes back only what was pawned.

effect.words: Somebody knows the old street under the Heights. Is it you?
effect.reply: Might be. Folk who know it don't shout it in the lane. You found the cache, so you know I'm not much of a ghost. Ask me straight what I did, and I'll tell you straight.

effect.words: Do you keep watch for her?
effect.reply: Somebody has to whistle. She's cleverer than the whole Heights lot. If you're going to name her, name me too. It's only fair.

phases.journal: Another pledge gone, and all the Heights talk of Gifts.

effects.text: Another pledge gone, and the whole Heights whispering about Gifts. Petra wants a plain answer, and nobody will give her one.
